article.title: Effects of an e-health enhanced multicomponent outpatient intervention for children and adolescents with overweight or obesity in routine primary care (STARKIDS): a cluster-randomized controlled trial.
article.authors: Ziser K, Erschens R, Zipfel S
article.abstract: Pediatric obesity is a major global public health challenge, associated with increased risk for numerous sequelae, persistence into adulthood, and growing economic burden. STARKIDS is a stepwise, tailored, e-health-enhanced, family-focused intervention in primary care. It integrates nutritional counseling targeting dietary energy density reduction, physical activity promotion, behavioral strategies, and psychosocial support.
